title: EXP-120 - Hello World Part 8 Phase 3: StaticCount and EditCount (Variable FX_Count) in FlexLayoutButtons' count Region and ButtonAddToCart in Its cart Region of FX_CustomerPortal, with a Close/Reopen Readback
objective: Build Hello World Part 8 Phase 3 (04:47-06:39) on FX_CustomerPortal (User scope) in FlexLayoutHome > Region04: buttons > FlexLayoutButtons (EXP-113): a Static StaticCount (Caption FX_sCount = Count) and an Edit EditCount (Justification Left, Binding Type Variable, variable FX_Count set through the Binding ellipsis, Size 7; 1.5) in its count region, and a Button ButtonAddToCart (Caption FX_sAddToCart = Add To Cart, Theme Class FX_BlueButton, Size 20; 1.5) in its cart region. Missing strings are created through the Caption ellipsis (AGENTS.md FX_ string scope). Operator decisions 2026-10-19: the shopping-cart Bitmap and Image and Text are left out (no image in assets/); the variable is named FX_Count. The narrated Regenerate is not needed (EXP-118: Save plus reopen suffices) and not authorized. T1 gate and string check; T2 StaticCount; T3 EditCount; T4 ButtonAddToCart; T5 close/reopen readback and final audit. Findings are observed only.

Create or update only experiments/EXP-120-hello-world-part-8-phase-3-count-and-add-to-cart.md and evidence/EXP-120/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If a session expiry, logout card or sign-in page appears, record it and stop for the operator (EXP-107: the operator signs in manually); do not navigate, type credentials or screenshot a filled sign-in form. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, dialog, menu or unsaved change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action. Signed-out session (EXP-116): a server-event error together with a portal tab reading 'Logout Successful' means the session ended; record it and stop for the operator.

Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it. Turn budget (EXP-109, EXP-111): if a task cannot finish, stop only at a step boundary right after a Save (never with an unsaved change, open list, editor or dialog) and report the next step.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error. Console-error stop (EXP-110-R2 lesson: a Caption commit can fail silently with HTTP 400 and surface only at the next server event): record the page console error count shown in the browser tool output at the start of each task and after every action in T1 to T5; if it rises after any action, record the action and the counts and stop blocked before any further click (no ellipsis, no Save, no close), leaving the state for the operator. Never read or inspect the console messages themselves. A rise can also come from a client-side Designer script error (EXP-111 T5: an uncaught TypeError at a component selection); the stop rule is the same, and the operator diagnoses the cause from the tool-written console log. A Caption commit that leaves Save disabled is also a stop signal (EXP-110-R2): record it and stop blocked before any further click.

Editing scope: stay in User scope throughout. If an 'Identify Your Editing Scope' dialog appears, confirm it shows User for the signed-in user and accept it unchanged; if it shows any other scope, Cancel it and stop blocked.

Designer gate (T1, read-only except at most one Form close and one open): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if another Form tab is active, select FX_CustomerPortal's tab; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree under FlexLayoutHome > Region04: buttons > FlexLayoutButtons: Region00: count, Region01: spacer and Region02: cart, all expected empty; if any holds a component or the tree differs, record it and stop blocked. Record the Details Variables tab contents (view only; FX_Count expected absent). String check: open Designer Edit menu > String once (Global Objects, Strings filter; the filter applies after clicking its search icon); filter FX_sHome as a positive control (expected Home), then FX_sCount and FX_sAddToCart; record each result and value with one screenshot and leave with Cancel; verify Save is still disabled. FX_sCount and FX_sAddToCart may be absent or present: present with exactly Count (FX_sCount) or Add To Cart (FX_sAddToCart) is reused without the ellipsis; present with any other value stops the run blocked. Locate the buttons band of the homepage column (below the grid band; a view-only canvas scroll is allowed) and its count and cart columns. Record the baseline console error count and one screenshot of the tree with the buttons band.

Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript. Use inline untargeted snapshots; never save snapshots to files and Grep them (EXP-109 ran out of turns that way). Lists (EXP-111 lesson): choose a list option by clicking it; never pick options with arrow keys, Enter or Tab while a list is open, because Tab commits the highlighted item. Stale references (operator ruling, EXP-111): the allowance is one fresh untargeted snapshot per 'Ref not found' error, not one per task. Snapshot size (EXP-114): if an untargeted snapshot is too large to return inline, take targeted snapshots of the needed panel instead (record that); never save snapshots to files.

Component rules (EXP-106, EXP-111, EXP-114): Placement: click the component's row in the Toolbox once (Static, Edit or Button), then click once inside the target band of FlexLayoutButtons (count: its left column; cart: its right column; away from dividers and adorner icons; a view-only canvas scroll is allowed first); record the Components tree: the new component must be a child of the target FlexLayoutButtons region (StaticCount and EditCount in Region00: count, ButtonAddToCart in Region02: cart). A component anywhere else gets the toolbar Undo once and the run stops blocked. Never drag. Record its defaults (Name, Size, Flex Attributes, Justification, Binding Type). Name: plain fill and Tab; verify it in the Components tree (labels lag). Record the console error count after each action. Caption (EXP-110, EXP-111): click the Caption value cell, type the string ID key by key, leave the field by clicking the Description row (never Tab); no accessibility snapshot while the Caption list is open (use a screenshot); verify the committed Caption and that Save became enabled. String (EXP-110-R3): if T1 found the string with its planned value, do not click the ellipsis; otherwise click the Caption ellipsis once, expect the prompt 'String <ID> does not exist. Create it?' (record verbatim), Yes once, in the String editor replace the pre-filled value with the planned value by one plain fill and Tab, verify, OK once; if the prompt names another ID or an editor shows an existing value, leave it with OK unchanged and stop blocked. Lists (Justification, Binding Type, Theme Class): open the list and click the option, then leave the field by clicking the Description row; if the arrow is not exposed, a value-cell double-click may show it; if the planned option is absent, close the list without choosing and stop blocked before the Save. Size: double-click the Layout Size row, then Width and Height by plain fill and Tab (skip a field that already holds its value and record that); record the Size summary. At most one correction per field. After each performed step exactly one Designer Save, recording its response and the Save state. Answer an OK-only informational prompt with OK and record it verbatim; any other prompt not covered here: record it, choose the non-changing answer (No or Cancel) and stop blocked. Leave every other property unchanged (Bitmap File Name and Image and Text stay at their defaults).

StaticCount (T2): A Static, Name StaticCount, Save; B Caption FX_sCount (string FX_sCount = Count created through the ellipsis only if T1 found it absent), Save. Two Designer Saves. Screenshots: placement with the tree; the committed Caption; each Save response state.

EditCount (T3): A Edit placed in the count column to the right of StaticCount, Name EditCount, Save. B Justification Left; Binding Type Variable (record the options); then click the Binding ellipsis once and record the dialog that opens (title, fields, options) with a screenshot before any entry. If it offers a variable-name field or list, enter FX_Count (key by key in a text field, or click an existing FX_Count entry) and confirm with OK; if it asks for anything else (a value, a type, a new collection) or offers no way to name the variable, record it, Cancel and stop blocked before the Save. Record Binding Type and Binding as displayed and the Variables tab (view only), then one Designer Save. C Width 7, Height 1.5, Save. Three Designer Saves. Screenshots: placement with the tree; the Binding dialog before the entry; Binding values before the Save; the Size before the Save; each Save response state.

ButtonAddToCart (T4): A Button placed in the cart column, Name ButtonAddToCart, Save; B Caption FX_sAddToCart (string FX_sAddToCart = Add To Cart created through the ellipsis only if T1 found it absent), Save; C Theme Class FX_BlueButton, Width 20, Height 1.5, Save. Three Designer Saves. Screenshots: placement with the tree; the committed Caption; the C values before the Save; each Save response state.

Readback and audit (T5, one task): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, record the Components tree (StaticCount and EditCount under Region00: count, ButtonAddToCart under Region02: cart, everything else unchanged), select each by its Components row (or Type cell) and read its planned values, the Variables tab, and what the canvas shows in the buttons band; check FX_sCount and FX_sAddToCart read-only through Edit menu > String (filter each; Cancel). Open no other dialog or list. Leave FX_CustomerPortal open and clean. Then, in the same task, write the documentation-only final audit into the record: decisive evidence for each acceptance check, the cumulative action audit with exact counts, the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory and the final state. Screenshots: the reopened canvas with the tree; one per component's Properties; one Strings check.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references (one per error). ExtJS comboboxes are not <select> elements (EXP-101): open their list and click the option. Coordinates are allowed only for the three canvas placement clicks (T2, T3, T4) and, once per field, for a list arrow that has no reference; record each such click. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection; never leave a prompt, list, editor or dialog open across tasks. Classify findings as observed only.
